description: Add a CloudWatch alarm on CPU utilization with evaluation_periods that avoid paging on-call for a single noisy spike, and an actions_enabled + alarm_actions wiring so it actually notifies anyone
prompts: There is no alerting at all on the aws_instance.worker CPU usage - it can peg at 100% for hours before anyone notices. Add an aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm resource named `worker_high_cpu`: metric_name = "CPUUtilization", namespace = "AWS/EC2", statistic = "Average", period = 300 (5-minute datapoints), threshold = 80, comparison_operator = "GreaterThanThreshold", evaluation_periods = 3 (must breach for 3 CONSECUTIVE 5-minute periods before firing - a single noisy spike must not page anyone), dimensions = { InstanceId = aws_instance.worker.id }, and alarm_actions = [aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn] (a reference to the existing aws_sns_topic.alerts resource - do not hardcode an ARN string, and do not modify the existing aws_instance or aws_sns_topic resources).

test_setup_files.check_alarm.py:
import json
import re
import subprocess

init = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'init', '-backend=false', '-input=false'],
                      capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
assert init.returncode == 0, f'terraform init failed:\n{init.stdout}\n{init.stderr}'

validate = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'validate', '-no-color', '-json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(validate.stdout)
assert data.get('valid') is True, f'terraform validate failed: {validate.stdout}\n{validate.stderr}'

content = open('main.tf', encoding='utf-8').read()

alarm = re.search(
    r'resource\s+"aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm"\s+"worker_high_cpu"\s*\{(.*?)\n\}',
    content, re.DOTALL,
)
assert alarm, 'aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.worker_high_cpu not found'
block = alarm.group(1)

checks = {
    'metric_name': r'metric_name\s*=\s*"CPUUtilization"',
    'namespace': r'namespace\s*=\s*"AWS/EC2"',
    'statistic': r'statistic\s*=\s*"Average"',
    'period': r'period\s*=\s*300',
    'threshold': r'threshold\s*=\s*80',
    'comparison_operator': r'comparison_operator\s*=\s*"GreaterThanThreshold"',
}
for label, pattern in checks.items():
    assert re.search(pattern, block), f'{label} missing or wrong in the alarm block'

m = re.search(r'evaluation_periods\s*=\s*(\d+)', block)
assert m, 'evaluation_periods missing'
assert int(m.group(1)) >= 3, (
    f'evaluation_periods is {m.group(1)} - must be at least 3 consecutive breaches to avoid '
    f'paging on-call for a single noisy spike')

assert re.search(r'InstanceId\s*=\s*aws_instance\.worker\.id', block), (
    'dimensions.InstanceId must reference aws_instance.worker.id')

assert re.search(r'alarm_actions\s*=\s*\[\s*aws_sns_topic\.alerts\.arn\s*\]', block), (
    'alarm_actions must reference aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn, not a hardcoded ARN string')

assert 'ami-0123456789abcdef0' in content, 'aws_instance.worker must stay unchanged'
assert 'ops-alerts' in content, 'aws_sns_topic.alerts must stay unchanged'

print('PASS CloudWatch alarm checks')
